Package net.sourceforge.plantuml.klimt.drawing.raster

Interface RasterCanvas

All Known Implementing Classes:
PngCanvas
public interface RasterCanvas
A raster surface that UGraphicRaster draws on, and encodes as PNG.

It follows the conventions of Java2D, which UGraphicG2d uses for the PNG output of the JVM: coordinates in pixels with y going down, scaled by scale(double); colors as 0xAARRGGBB; strokes as java.awt.BasicStroke; text drawn with its baseline at y. Paint, stroke and clip are a state, kept until changed, as in a Graphics2D.

The TeaVM C build implements it with a native library (no AWT); the tests implement it with Java2D, to check the drivers against UGraphicG2d.
